views.name: resource_disclosure
views.definition:
SELECT r.id,
    jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('field', '{"moduleId": "m", "elementId": "resourceId", "documentId": "domain"}'::jsonb, 'disposition', 'original', 'value', jsonb_build_object('string', r.id)), security_raw.note_cell(p.bag),
        CASE
            WHEN (r.id = 'RAB'::text) THEN jsonb_build_object('field', '{"moduleId": "m", "elementId": "salary", "documentId": "domain"}'::jsonb, 'disposition', 'transformed', 'outputType', '{"moduleId": "m", "elementId": "resourceId", "documentId": "domain"}'::jsonb, 'value', jsonb_build_object('string', 'restricted'))
            ELSE jsonb_build_object('field', '{"moduleId": "m", "elementId": "salary", "documentId": "domain"}'::jsonb, 'disposition', 'withheld')
        END) AS cells
   FROM (security_raw.resource r
     LEFT JOIN security_raw.resource_private_carrier p ON ((p.resource_id = r.id)));

views.name: resource_project
views.definition:
SELECT r.id AS resource_id,
    o.project_id
   FROM (((security_raw.resource r
     JOIN security_raw.m2m_resource_project o ON ((o.resource_id = r.id)))
     JOIN security_raw.m2m_employee_project a ON (((a.project_id = o.project_id) AND a.active)))
     JOIN security_raw.employee e ON ((e.id = a.employee_id)))
  WHERE (e.native_login = (SESSION_USER)::text);

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

routines.name: revoke_alice
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security_drain.revoke_alice()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(10070019);
 UPDATE security_raw.m2m_employee_project SET active=false WHERE employee_id='Alice';
 RETURN 'revoked';
END
$function$

scope: One participating raw realm: ordinary reader holds session advisory shared lease beyond data commit until a controlled consumer acknowledges final publication/discard; ordinary revoker takes exclusive transaction lease and acknowledges after commit. Independent/nonparticipating writers, coordinator failure and general release paths remain separate requirements. Native-session loss is an unsafe negative control; persistent publisher refusal is still required before L03 acceptance. Actual runtime ordinary read and ordinary guarded revocation with independent PG lock/authority observation; final controlled consumer acknowledgment precedes lease release. Original journal custody retained. Not registered L03 or complete backend qualification.
